svg.title: StudySpot app (Flutter): MVVM class diagram, M5 part of Sprint 1

g.text: StudySpot app (Flutter): MVVM class diagram, M5 part of Sprint 1
Flutter widget: draws the screen, no logic
plain Dart: screen state + rules, testable without UI; View rebuilds on notify()
one per feature: hides the API from the ViewModel
ApiClient has two implementations (Strategy): DioApiClient talks to the real backend; MockApiClient runs the tests.
